verdict.rationale: xAI's docs clearly cover commercial terms (self-serve signup, per-model pricing, cost-tracking) and data-handling commitments (default 30-day retention, opt-in Zero Data Retention with header confirmation), giving a founder plain-language clarity on billing and data handling. However, there is no evidence of an actual usage policy or acceptable-use terms listing prohibited uses/build restrictions anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: an explicit prohibited-uses/acceptable-use policy document, plain-language statement of what may not be built with the models, and any linkage between usage policy and the API terms.
